recorder: website/tools/record_eval.py job list, pipeline_at() and run_eval() (imported unchanged) driven by rec_split.py so two processes share the clips; eval args --local 1 --no-video-flag
before_pipeline_check: for every gate, the commit record_eval picks has a pipeline.py blob equal to the gate's frozen_pipeline; this needs TZ=UTC because the gates ran on UTC nodes (gate times are naive)
capture: patch_video_robotwin.py as of origin/main 360d8cb (old sampling): a 320x240 head-camera frame on every 4th _step/_hold call and on every public API call, written at 8 fps; capture covers the pipeline run, not the 50 settle steps (0.2 s) before the success check

trees.raw: mp4 exactly as the patch writes it (8 fps, plays ~8x slower than sim time)
trees.realtime: same frames, retimed with ffmpeg -itsscale (no re-encode) to rt_fps = n_frames / captured_sim_s; frame gaps are uneven in sim time (dense during arm motion, sparse during holds), so motion plays near 1x and holds are compressed

fields.sim_steps: simulation steps incl. the 50 settle steps (DT = 1/250 s)
fields.captured_sim_s: sim time covered by the capture: (sim_steps - 50) * DT, or sim_steps * DT when the step limit ended the episode
fields.wall_clock_s: episode wall clock on a shared GB10 (rendering every frame dominates)
fields.tries: every seed offset run for this clip, in order; the clip is the last try (record_eval rule)
